question: How much tax does Alice have to pay in 2012?
text: Alice shares a house with her father Bob since 2007. Alice pays for 75% of the costs of the house, while Charlie, her brother, pays for the remaining 25%. Alice's gross income for the year 2012 was $67285 and Charlie's was $56174. Alice is allowed itemized deductions of $17817. Alice elects to itemize her deductions for 2012.
